channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump downplays US-Iran differences as he heads to Beijing to meet with Xi
item.description: Trump gives conflicting messages on prominence of Iran war in upcoming talks, with his administration emphasising trade.

item.title: Trump backs Pakistan as Iran mediator after criticism from Lindsey Graham
item.description: US president lauds Islamabad, but his Republican ally says he does not trust Pakistan to facilitate Iran diplomacy.

item.title: Why is Iran increasingly targeting the UAE in its war messaging?
item.description: The UAE's close ties to the US and Israel have placed the Gulf country under Iranian suspicion.

item.title: Ukraine hits Russia’s distant gas facilities after Moscow’s attacks kill 6
item.description: The attack comes in retaliation for the Russian attacks that killed at least six in Ukraine, according to the president.

item.title: Trump skirts question on US ‘red lines’ for Iran ceasefire
item.description: Trump skirted a question from a reporter about whether he has a ‘red line’ that would end the ceasefire with Iran.

item.title: Israel sent Iron Dome anti-missile batteries and personnel to UAE: US envoy
item.description: Mike Huckabee calls on Gulf states to 'pick a side' in the war between Israel and Iran as he heaps praise on Abu Dhabi.

item.title: US faces rising costs with Iran war driving energy prices, inflation higher
item.description: Consumer prices spike in April, driven by soaring energy costs, with petrol prices up nearly 30 percent since last year.

item.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
item.description: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

item.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.

item.title: US inflation jumps to 3.8% as energy costs surge from Iran war
item.description: The key measure of US inflation rises its highest level since May 2023 as consumers feel the impact of the Iran war.
